_description: Short fixture: single-room powder-room + laundry refresh. Proves the deliberate ONE-PAGE architect layout and a compact client brief. De-identified fictional data. No clientPresentation block (tests the editorial fallback / no-palette path).

clientBrief.subtitle: Powder room + laundry refresh
overview: Priya wants a clean, hard-wearing refresh of the existing powder room and adjoining laundry: new finishes, better storage and improved lighting, keeping the current wall and plumbing positions wherever practical to control cost.
clientBrief.priorityNote: Lift a tired powder room and laundry without major structural change.

scopeIn.text: Strip and re-fit the powder room: new vanity, toilet suite, tiling and lighting.
Laundry refresh: new bench, cabinetry and tiled splashback; retain appliance positions.

items.text: Moving walls or relocating plumbing stacks — excluded to keep the scope fixed.
Warm neutral tiles with a matte black tapware accent.
Timber-look laminate cabinetry to match the kitchen.

noted.label: Working assumptions
items: Existing waterproofing to be assessed; re-do assumed in the powder room.
No changes to the switchboard are expected.

decisions.action: Confirm whether the laundry splashback is tiled or a single laminate panel.
Confirm tapware finish (matte black vs brushed) against the kitchen.

paras: With these two decisions confirmed, Blue Leaf prepares a fixed-scope quotation. As this is a small, defined refresh there is no separate pre-construction (PTSA) stage.

actions.action: Confirm powder-room waterproofing extent and set-down against the existing slab.
Confirm laundry cabinetry run and bench depth against the appliance positions.
